mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_accounting_period (id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{calendarId}, #{fiscalYear}, #{periodNo}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{reopenCount}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_accounting_period SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{period.id} AND status = #{period.status} AND version = #{period.version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND end_date < #{startDate} AND status <> 'CLOSED' ORDER BY start_date LIMIT 1

SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND start_date > #{startDate} AND status IN ('CLOSED', 'CLOSING', 'REOPENING') ORDER BY start_date LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_accounting_period SET status = 'OPEN', reopen_count = reopen_count + 1, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{period.id} AND status = 'REOPENING' AND version = #{period.version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_id, fiscal_year, period_no, start_date, end_date, status, reopen_count, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_period WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND start_date <= #{date} AND end_date >= #{date}
